identity.symptom: sqlite migration command selects unsupported better-sqlite3 on bun

what: New SQLite database/auth applications cannot apply their generated migrations under Bun.
expected: Supported generated db:migrate applies SQLite migrations under Bun and safely repeats.
observed: bun --bun drizzle-kit migrate selects better-sqlite3 and exits 1 with its explicit Bun unsupported-driver error.
root_cause: packages/create-relkit/src/render-database.ts unconditionally generated bun --bun drizzle-kit migrate for SQLite; pinned Kit chooses the installed Node-only better-sqlite3 driver. The app already uses bun:sqlite, whose supported Drizzle migrator avoids that driver. A Node control also failed due this machine's native ABI mismatch.
fixed_by: For SQLite, emit scripts/migrate.ts using drizzle-orm/bun-sqlite/migrator, guard persistent DATABASE_PATH, close the client in finally and point db:migrate to it. Retain existing non-SQLite commands. Original failing regressions, fresh real CLI creation/addition/migration replay, main app auth/commerce HTTP, adjacent dialects and guardrails pass.

invariants: SQLite migrations work under Bun without Node-only drivers
Repeated migration does not duplicate journal entries
Database/auth scaffold and other dialects remain valid

environment.monitoring: Real source CLI diagnostics, native migration command exits, SQLite catalog/journal queries and TypeScript diagnostics; existing local runtime HTTP logs. No remote telemetry configured in this local app.

reproduction: Create a fresh supported minimal app, add auth with SQLite using the actual CLI.
Use the pinned installed Drizzle Kit and generated db:generate script.
Run generated db:migrate under Bun; require zero exit and four auth tables.
The original command exits 1 before migration. Preserve unit and real CLI logs before editing.
After fix rebuild the generator, repackage templates, create another disposable app through real CLI and repeat migrations twice.
